verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents an automated follow-up reminder system that drafts nudges and resurfaces threads needing a response when no reply has come ('automatically reminded to follow up—with a draft already written', 'check which emails have been read, draft all the nudges, and send when each recipient is most likely to open it'), closely matching the reminder half of the story. However, there is no explicit mention of a 'snooze' feature to temporarily hide a conversation and resurface it later, which is a core part of the story. Missing for 10: explicit snooze/defer-conversation functionality, independent/hands-on confirmation of the follow-up reminder behavior.
